name: Crab, Ham & Veggie Bake

descriptions.normal: A luxurious bake. Cracks through the golden outer skin reveal a medley of rosy ham and bright vegetables. How tantalizing!
descriptions.suspicious: A somewhat luxurious bake. By looking at it, no one can tell what it is made of... or what it lacks.
descriptions.delicious: A luxurious bake. The scent is so rich and heavenly. You'll only be done once you've licked the plate clean.

effectTexts.normal: Revives a character and restores 1,200 HP.
effectTexts.suspicious: Revives a character and restores 900 HP.
effectTexts.delicious: Revives a character and restores 1,500 HP.

recipeHint: Complete the Lively Orlean version of Food Delivery
